# has agreement name

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:hasAgreementName`](gmeow-hasAgreementName.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/hasAgreementName>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/names`](../../slices/names.md)

Relates an agreement to a structured [`gmeow:AgreementName`](../classes/gmeow-AgreementName.md) it bears; the agreement-scoped specialization of [`gmeow:hasAppellation`](gmeow-hasAppellation.md). Non-functional — an agreement may bear many co-equal names (formal title, short name, multilingual versions); none is primary.
